text: Make a silent 7-second widescreen clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera. Put “Maya Chen” with “Community Gardener” underneath at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. Use white lettering on a dark backing, not over her face. No other text.
